groups.title: Dog breeds named after places
groups.explanation: Each breed carries the name of the region it is said to come from.

groups.title: Canadian provinces
groups.explanation: All four are provinces of Canada.

groups.title: Canadian cities
groups.explanation: Each is a Canadian city, and three of them are provincial capitals.

sources.excerpt: The Dalmatian is a breed of dog with a white coat marked with dark-coloured spots.
Queen Victoria owned a particularly small Pomeranian, and consequently, the smaller variety became universally popular.
The Labrador Retriever, also known simply as the Labrador or Lab, is a British breed of retriever gun dog.
The German Shepherd, also known in Britain as an Alsatian, is a German breed of working dog of medium to large size.
In 1912, the boundaries of Quebec, Ontario, and Manitoba were expanded northward: Manitoba's to the 60° parallel, Ontario's to Hudson Bay and Quebec's to encompass the District of Ungava.
However, some provinces such as Saskatchewan, Prince Edward Island and Newfoundland and Labrador have experienced long periods of stagnation or population decline.
In September 1905, a portion of the North-West Territories south of the 60th parallel north became the provinces of Alberta and Saskatchewan.
Halifax is an economic centre of Atlantic Canada, home to a concentration of government offices and private companies.
As of 2021, Winnipeg had a city population of 749,607 and a metropolitan population of 834,678, making it Canada's sixth-largest city and eighth-largest metropolitan area.
Calgary is the largest city in the Canadian province of Alberta.
Calgary became the first city in the North-West Territories, receiving its charter a decade before Edmonton and Regina.

editorNotes: Labrador is the tile with two homes, a retriever and part of the province of Newfoundland and Labrador; the province group is complete with Alberta, Manitoba, Ontario and Saskatchewan, so Labrador is counted as a dog. Newfoundland is also a dog and a province, so it was left out to keep a single ambiguity. Halifax is a Yorkshire town as well as a Canadian city, but no group here asks for English towns.
